say:2:1830132001:1.text: We're on the hunt for good food... but after all this walking, still nothing decent!
say:2:1830132001:1.source_cn: 我们在寻找美食……走了半天，这鬼地方怎么连个美食店都没有？

say:3:1830132002:1.text: It never crossed my mind that the Graveborn could survive without food...
say:3:1830132002:1.source_cn: 谁能想到亡灵居然不用吃东西……

say:4:1830132003:1.text: Shouldn't there be a store catering to stowaways, selling Bantus specialties and the like?
say:4:1830132003:1.source_cn: 说不定会有亡灵做偷渡者的生意，卖一些“班题斯特色小吃”...

say:5:1830132004:1.text: Are you sure you'd dare eat them?
say:5:1830132004:1.source_cn: 班题斯特色小吃？你敢吃吗？

say:6:1830132005:1.text: It could be a trap to kidnap us and haul us off to Bantus!
say:6:1830132005:1.source_cn: 没准吃完咱们就昏过去了，再睁眼的时候就被班题斯绑到了马车上！

say:7:1830132006:1.text: What should we do, then? We can't survive on air!
say:7:1830132006:1.source_cn: 那我们怎么办？总不能喝西北风填肚子吧？

say:8:1830132007:1.text: Just keep looking... There's got to be a tavern somewhere in this area!
say:8:1830132007:1.source_cn: 再找找吧……我就不信这里一家酒馆都没有！
